item.title: Japanese Vocabulary Review App
item.description: A Python application to review Japanese vocabulary, built to support my own study toward JLPT N4.
item.content:encoded:
Since moving to Tokyo, I’ve been learning Japanese, currently around JLPT N5-N4 level. To make vocabulary review more effective than flashcard apps I’d tried, I built my own Python application for reviewing Japanese vocabulary.

It’s a small, focused tool tailored to how I actually study, and it’s still under active development as my needs (and my Japanese) evolve.

Status: active, ongoing.
